records.name: SRH Hochschule in Nordrhein-Westfalen

The official SRH University website has a page for SRH Campus Hamm (https://www.srh-university.de/en/our-campuses/hamm/)

records.name: Fachhochschule für Finanzen
evidence: The institution started as the Fachhochschule für Finanzen (FHF) in 1976. The Fachhochschulgesetz öffentlicher Dienst renamed it Hochschule für Finanzen (HSF) on 14 December 2019 (https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hochschule_f%C3%BCr_Finanzen_Nordrhein-Westfalen, used only as a source for the rename)

Studis Online confirms the rename took effect in December 2019. It gives the earlier name as Fachhochschule für Finanzen Nordrhein Westfalen (FHF NRW) (https://www.studis-online.de/hochschulen/fhf-nrw/)

The NRW finance administration runs the HSF website as a section of its own site. That section's subpages describe the HSF's three locations: Nordkirchen, Herford and Hamminkeln (https://www.finanzverwaltung.nrw.de/dienststellen/hochschule-fur-finanzen-nrw/aussenstandorte-der-hsf)

Karriere.NRW lists the Hochschule für Finanzen Nordrhein-Westfalen at Schloss, 59394 Nordkirchen and names https://www.finanzverwaltung.nrw.de as its website (https://karriere.nrw/dienststelle/a84cb580-61e1-44a1-bc16-7dc672cf3c91)

The old domain fhf-nordkirchen.de redirects to the HSF section on finanzverwaltung.nrw.de, according to the automatic check that was provided as input. The exact form of the URL path is not fully confirmed: the input redirect uses 'fuer', but a subpage found in search uses 'fur'

The old source URL on landesfinanzschule-edenkoben.fin-rlp.de showed the same institution with the same address and email, but its newest content dates from 2023. This suggests the site has moved from fin-rlp.de to rlp.de (https://landesfinanzschule-edenkoben.fin-rlp.de/startseite)

The ministry page names the joint institution 'Hochschule für Finanzen und Landesfinanzschule Rheinland-Pfalz' in Edenkoben and confirms it has run since 1981. It also lists an older web address, www.hochschule-finanzen-rlp.de (https://fm.rlp.de/ministerium/karriere/hochschule-fuer-finanzen)
Third-party directories also list landesfinanzschule-edenkoben.rlp.de as the website (https://studieren.de/hs-fuer-finanzen-rheinlandpfalz.hochschule.t-0.a-132.html)

The institution was still operating in September 2025, when it celebrated its 75th anniversary in Edenkoben (https://www.pfalz-express.de/edenkoben-75-jahre-hochschule-fuer-finanzen-und-landesfinanzschule-rheinland-pfalz/)
